answer.answer: Amine-functionalised polystyrene nanoparticles (PS-NH2) are consistently reported with positive zeta potentials in the literature, so none of the reported values are negative. Yes, these particles are positively charged, though the exact magnitude varies with pH and ionic strength of the suspending medium.
